answer: Given how into mixology you've gotten, a cocktail night at your place would be an easy win — pour everyone the Limoncello Paloma or a round of Bee's Knees with your homemade syrups, and set out a few bitters so people can build their own Old Fashioned. If you'd rather get out of the apartment, a vintage/thrift crawl through the trendy part of town with dinner after is low-effort to organize, or a tee time if enough of the group golfs. Either one scales well to a steady friend group and doesn't need much notice.
